metaphors.title: Ferrari at the marathon
metaphors.paraphrase: Using AI is like showing up to a marathon in a Ferrari, or with steroids; cars got their own sport, Formula 1.

metaphors.title: Fast food, slow food
metaphors.paraphrase: Fast math and slow math as two modalities, borrowed from the slow food movement.

metaphors.title: Pascal's sphere
metaphors.paraphrase: Mathematics as an infinite sphere; beyond human understanding, inscrutable trophies of alien intelligence; LLMs doing math for a nascent civilization.
